rows_new.F15_tail1s_lsml: 15 families (as V1/V2); marks = tie-aware top-1 step per answer and family (the maximal step; boundary ties share the single mark), centred within answer; marks z-scored over the pooled fit rows; lsml_continuous (unit loading scale, small_m_guard); Spearman orientation on continuous F15 with the level_entropy anchor; weights applied to continuous F15, then within-answer z
rows_new.B11_tail1s_lsml: bank11 channels as the frozen bank11 L-SML uses them (answer-z, NOT sign-oriented); marks = tie-aware top-1 of each raw channel; otherwise as F15_tail1s_lsml; anchor entropy (column 0); weights applied to continuous bank11
rows_new.B11o_tail1s_lsml: bank11 channels oriented by the V1 lock source_signs (label-derived, like the families); marks = tie-aware top-1 of each oriented channel (the maximal-risk step); otherwise as B11_tail1s_lsml; weights applied to continuous oriented bank11

why_two_bank11_rows: the maximal step depends on channel orientation; the frozen bank11 representation is unoriented (L-SML learns signs) while the families are oriented. Both are declared so no orientation is chosen from results.
